column1: # Why measures: the pointwise gate trips on three V(11) crosstalk tail
# samples at 2.4 mV that differ by 0.13 mV (5.4 percent relative on a
# 1 V-scale node). Refining ngspice's own step 5x moves its half-swing
# crossings by up to 57 ps, the V(11) crosstalk peak by 35 mV (3.5
# percent), and the settled rail means by 17 mV; RSpice's crossings sit
# within 28 ps, its V(11) peak within 34 mV, and its means within 4 mV
# Source: VS1/VS2 PULSE 0->5 V at 15.9 ns, 5->0 V at 31.7 ns (0.2 ns
# edges) into a coupled 4-line ladder. V(5), V(6), V(8), V(9), V(10),
# V(12) swing rail to rail; V(7) and V(11) are the coupled-line
# crosstalk nodes (0.6-1.0 V peaks). Tolerances are twice the larger of
# the reference's refinement movement and RSpice's deviation.
